payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear overview of the diverse topics discussed on Reddit, including specific examples and the nature of discussions within various subreddits.

claims.text: Reddit discussions cover a wide range of topics including climate change, abortion, world news, relationship advice, and artificial intelligence.
Subreddits oriented around politics and religion tend to exhibit higher levels of dogmatism compared to those focused on hobbies like cooking.
Users who are dogmatic about one topic, such as politics, are likely to express dogmatic views on unrelated topics like science and technology.
Dogmatic discussions on Reddit also include topics like guns, LGBT issues, and economics.
